## Change and acceptance criteria

Link the task; describe the observable result and boundaries.

## Verification

List commands, actual results, skipped checks and artifact/log links.

## Self-review

- [ ] Relevant code and callers inspected; diff limited to this task.
- [ ] Regression tests added where behavior changes; existing checks retained.
- [ ] Storage/legacy compatibility and narrow/wide/native impact reviewed.
- [ ] No credentials or personal vault fixtures.
- [ ] Assumptions, risks and untested platforms stated.
- [ ] Release intent explicit; use `[skip release]` in merge commit if appropriate.

Human review required. Agent must not merge or publish without authorization.
